# RealIRacing

> RealIRacing (realiracing.com) is an iRacing sim racing site by Carlos Martinez: practical guides on force feedback settings, wheel and pedal buyer's guides, safety rating and racecraft, car and track guides, and OBS streaming setups, plus race highlights, setup guides and rig tours on the @realtape YouTube channel. Real motorsport roots, tested on a real rig.

## About
- Author: Carlos Martinez (iRacing user "Carlos Martinez9"). Home: https://realiracing.com/
- Rig: MOZA R9 direct drive wheelbase, MOZA CS V2 wheel, MOZA SR-P pedals, RTX 5060 Ti, 1440p 120 Hz monitor. Full breakdown: https://realiracing.com/gear.html
- Affiliate disclosure: gear links go to Amazon and carry an affiliate tag; the author may earn a commission at no cost to the reader. The site does not use sponsored loaner hardware.
- 185 blog guides published so far; new posts appear several times a week.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://realiracing.com/): channel overview, content types, gear picks, FAQ
- [Blog](https://realiracing.com/blog/): all iRacing guides, settings and gear advice
- [My Rig](https://realiracing.com/gear.html): every part Carlos races and streams on, with notes on why
- [Link hub](https://realiracing.com/go/): all platforms in one place
- [YouTube @realtape](https://www.youtube.com/@realtape): race highlights, setup guides, rig tours, iRacing tips
- Social: [Instagram @realiracing](https://www.instagram.com/realiracing) · [TikTok @realiracing](https://www.tiktok.com/@realiracing) · [X @realiracing](https://x.com/realiracing)

- [How to Judge a Wheelbase Deal on Black Friday 2026](https://realiracing.com/blog/black-friday-wheelbase-deals-checklist-2026.html): A checklist for judging direct drive wheelbase deals on Black Friday (Nov 27) and Cyber Monday 2026: torque tier, box contents, ecosystem, mounting and returns.

- [How to Rejoin the Track Safely After a Spin in iRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/rejoining-the-track-safely-after-a-spin-iracing.html): What to do in the seconds after a spin in iRacing: stop the car, read the relative, pick a gap and rejoin parallel to the racing line without causing a wreck.
- [Sim Racing Black Friday 2026: What to Wait For | RealIRacing](https://realiracing.com/blog/sim-racing-black-friday-2026-what-to-wait-for.html): How to plan a sim racing purchase around Black Friday on November 27: what is worth waiting for, what is not, and how to check a deal is real.

- [Road Atlanta iRacing Guide: The Esses and Braking for Turn 10](https://realiracing.com/blog/road-atlanta-iracing-guide-esses-turn-10.html): Master Road Atlanta's technical Esses section and late-apex braking into Turn 10. Line, braking and setup guidance for iRacing drivers.
- [Wheel Rotation and Steering Ratio in iRacing, Explained](https://realiracing.com/blog/steering-rotation-and-ratio-iracing.html): Why your wheel's degrees of rotation should match the car, how soft lock and steering ratio work in iRacing, and how to set it up on a MOZA R9.

- [Laguna Seca iRacing Guide: The Corkscrew and Where to Brake](https://realiracing.com/blog/laguna-seca-iracing-guide-corkscrew-braking.html): A guide to WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca on iRacing: how to learn the blind crests, brake into the Corkscrew and tune force feedback.
- [The 15-Minute Monthly Check for a Fixed Sim Rig](https://realiracing.com/blog/sim-rig-monthly-check-bolts-pedals-quick-release.html): Loose bolts mimic bad force feedback and pedal drift. A monthly rig check for the frame, wheelbase, quick release, pedals and seat.
- [Sim Racing in an Apartment: Noise, Vibration and Neighbours](https://realiracing.com/blog/sim-racing-in-an-apartment-noise-vibration-neighbours.html): Where a sim rig's noise really comes from, what travels through floors, and the fixes that keep a direct drive rig neighbour-friendly.
- [Bass Shakers and Tactile Feedback: Real Benefit or Expensive Gimmick?](https://realiracing.com/blog/bass-shakers-tactile-feedback-worth-it.html): Do bass shakers justify the cost? A look at whether they improve lap times or just immersion, based on published specs and common setup practice.
- [Indianapolis Motor Speedway Oval: Trim, Drafting, and Speed](https://realiracing.com/blog/indianapolis-motor-speedway-oval-drafting-trim.html): Learn Indy's high-speed oval with proper trim setup and drafting technique. Trim ranges, tow distance and brake bias starting points for consistent top-10 pace.
- [Dirt Late Model iRacing Guide: Setup, Technique, and Racecraft](https://realiracing.com/blog/dirt-late-model-iracing-guide.html): Master dirt late model racing on iRacing. Learn setup fundamentals, throttle control, and how to race clean on unpredictable surfaces.
